dataset_info.notes: MASSIVE voice-assistant utterances reused as a 52-language TTS read-aloud prompt set. TTS has no objective metric — fighters synthesise each prompt and the clips become blind A/B listening battles (human votes only). Cap with --max-samples for manageable battle pools.
